text:
Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. Your checkout is still open, so I'm writing myself rather than sending a banner. One plain word on timing: nothing in your bag is held until you check out, and the code below expires.

Your bag is still there, exactly as you left it. Pieces like this get pulled on for the first cold morning, kept on through the day and reached for again the week after, without thinking. It would be a shame for it to stop at the last page.

So, for this bag: 15%, on top of the 45% Autumn Sale already in your total. Your code:

{% coupon_code 'CHECKOUT15' %}

It goes in at checkout. Back to your checkout: {{ event.extra.checkout_url }}

If size is what stopped you, that's the easiest one to fix. Check the size guide on each product page; if you're between sizes, take both. Easy returns on the one that doesn't fit, within 30 days.

Delivery is 7 to 10 days; shipping is $8, on us from $150. Anything else, write to support@nora-lanelle.com.

Warmly,
Claire
Nora Lanelle
